blurb: Guests can participate in virtual and instructor-led educational programs aligned with standards, self-guided general admission, and special promotions like Kids Visit Free. Educational programs include interactive lessons on marine science, animal adaptations, and environmental impact. The aquarium also offers naming opportunities to support education programs.
extraNote: Virtual programs require full payment before access information is sent · No refunds on virtual program purchases; rescheduling possible if notified ahead · $100 non-refundable deposit required at booking for education groups · Total balance due 14 days prior to visit; payments non-refundable · SEA Grant applications approved on first-come, first-served basis; up to 6 weeks review time · All sales final for Kids Visit Free promotion; no retroactive pricing or refunds
